title: A Quiet Night in Night City
content: Spent the evening wandering through the city lights, trying to ignore the rumors about rogue AIs slipping through the Blackwall. Probably nothing to worry about... right?

title: Toss a Coin
content: Met a strange traveler at a local tavern today. White hair, yellow eyes, carried two swords. He barely spoke, but someone in the corner kept humming a familiar tune.

title: You Died
content: Today was rough. Missed my deadline, spilled coffee on my keyboard, and somehow locked myself out of my apartment. Felt like a Dark Souls loading screen was about to appear.

title: The Cake Was Definitely Not There
content: My coworker promised there would be free cake in the break room. Turns out it was just leftover salad. I should have known better.

title: Arrow to the Knee
content: Went for a run this morning and immediately pulled a muscle. Guess this is how adventuring careers really end.

title: One Last Save Point
content: Stayed up way too late replaying an old game for nostalgia. Told myself 'just one more mission'... suddenly it was 4 AM.

title: The Floor is Lava
content: Had a moment of panic when I thought I spilled hot coffee on the floor. Turns out it was just a shadow. My heart is still racing.

title: I Used to Be an Adventurer Like You
content: Tried to fix my bike today and ended up making it worse. Now it won't even roll. Maybe I should stick to being a pedestrian.

title: Press F to Pay Respects
content: Accidentally deleted an important file at work. Spent the next hour trying to recover it, but it was gone for good. F.

title: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
content: Went hiking alone and got lost in the woods for a few hours. Found my way back eventually, but it was definitely an adventure.

title: Moby Dick
content: Sailor Ishmael’s voyage on the whaler Pequod, which is commanded by the maniacal Captain Ahab. Ahab is obsessed with taking revenge on Moby Dick, a giant white sperm whale that bit off his leg, driving the ship into a fatal quest across the oceans.
author: Herman Melville
